mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which raises wage inflation and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and signals economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 4% and a fall in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average signals labor market imbalances, which can trigger policy tightening and uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in HOUST for three consecutive months indicates weakening housing demand, which negatively impacts construction and related sectors, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < previous month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL below 2% for two months signals a restrictive monetary policy with subdued inflation, which can depress growth expectations and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising AND CPIAUCSL < 2% for two months
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent monthly increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals rising household savings and reduced consumption, which compresses demand for equities and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.
